caveats: phaC presence comes from the uncapped protein-to-genome membership list (38,744 genomes). Every other family comes from a metadata join capped at 5 genomes per identical protein, so those counts are lower bounds, not exact.
1,763 phaC-positive genomes have no row in the metadata matrix, so they carry no taxonomy, habitat or coordinates and cannot appear on the map.
qTM structural scores exist only for the 95%-dereplication representatives, 15,867 of 33,770 proteins. Blank means not measured, not low.
Catalytic-triad completeness is scored by HMM alignment columns, which produces false negatives on divergent sequences; treat it as a floor.
ESMFold models and TemStaPro thermostability are predictions, not experimental measurements.
